icon_style.prompt: Draw exactly ONE small user-interface icon in the same hand-drawn ink line style as the reference picture: dark sepia-brown ink on plain parchment, bold uniform strokes (each stroke about 1/35 of the image width, the same weight everywhere), open line drawing kept very simple (a bold silhouette with at most a dozen strokes, no small repeated details), no hatching, no shading, no drop shadow, no glow, no fill except small solid accents, no colour other than the brown ink. The icon is centred and fills about 60 % of the square canvas, with a wide empty margin. The background is a plain, flat, uniform light parchment colour with no texture, no vignette, no frame, no border, no box around the icon. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature. Medieval subject matter (France and England, 1330-1450), clear silhouette readable at 24 pixels. Subject:

medallion_style.prompt: Paint a round illuminated medallion button in exactly the same style, palette and frame as the reference picture (Gothic French manuscript illumination, egg tempera, fine brown ink outlines): burnished gold outer ring with a dark outline, azure blue band decorated with thin white scrollwork, thin vermilion inner fillet, gold field inside, four small gold fleurons at the top, bottom, left and right. Keep the frame identical to the reference; only replace the bell in the centre by the new emblem, painted in the same way (gold, brown and a touch of azure or vermilion), large and simple, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat parchment background around the medallion. No text, no letters, no numbers. Emblem:
